historical_note: Supersedes exploratory schema 1.0.0 precomputed-OOF selection run; method selection in schema 1.1.0 uses strictly disjoint 3-way (base_rf / cal_fit / val) folds.

selection_governance.selection_rationale: Sigmoid (Platt) selected via 3-way disjoint CV: reduces validation Brier from 0.0326 to 0.0269, LogLoss from 0.2061 to 0.1207, and ECE from 0.0383 to 0.0041. Isotonic excluded due to low overall training minority support (train_pos=246 < 250 or prev=4.24% < 5.0%).
selection_governance.scientific_disclaimer: Calibrated probabilities estimate empirical Tox21 in-vitro assay activity frequency under the benchmark evaluation protocol; they do not represent clinical toxicity risk, in-vivo human safety, or regulatory suitability.

score_distribution_comparison.note: Base models in 3-way disjoint selection are trained on 60% of D_train (3/5 folds), final-fit OOF base models are trained on 80% of D_train (4/5 folds), and the deployed model is trained on 100% of D_train. While stratified folds preserve class ratios, smaller training subsets exhibit slightly higher finite-sample leaf variance.
